settings.editor: This Shipping & Delivery Policy explains how orders placed with Onyx Research Ltd are packed, dispatched and delivered.
Last updated: 9 July 2026
Every order leaves our facility via DHL Express, complete with tracking and a mandatory signature at the point of delivery.
Because Onyx Research products require careful handling, each parcel is packed with temperature controlled cooling elements to keep contents stable throughout transit.
At this time, our shipping network covers Europe, the United Kingdom and the Middle East exclusively (North America coming soon).
If you are located outside these regions and would like to explore delivery options, reach out to us at sales@onyxhealth.net and we will see what can be arranged.
Once payment clears, we prepare and dispatch orders within 1 to 3 business days.
From there, delivery generally takes another 1 to 3 business days across Europe and the UK, though actual timing varies by destination.
Busy periods or unforeseen circumstances can extend these windows.
Because our items are sensitive to temperature, every Onyx Research package ships with frozen gel packs to preserve product integrity.
Please make sure someone is available to accept the delivery on the first attempt. We cannot take responsibility for product spoilage if a delivery fails because no one was on hand to receive it.
Every shipment requires an adult signature at the delivery address supplied during checkout; DHL will not leave parcels unattended.
If no adult is present to sign, it is the customer's responsibility to work out alternate arrangements directly with DHL.
It is the customer's responsibility to enter accurate, complete shipping details at checkout.
Should a delivery fail due to a mistaken address, we will attempt redirection through DHL where possible.
If the error originated on our end, we will cover the cost of reshipping; otherwise, the customer covers the cost of redelivery.
We cannot be held responsible for delays or added fees stemming from address errors.
Shipping charges are calculated automatically at checkout based on destination and package weight.
We do not currently offer free shipping, and rates may change at any time without prior notice.
As soon as your order ships, you will receive an email with your DHL tracking number so you can follow your parcel's progress on the DHL website.
Should the first delivery attempt fail, DHL automatically schedules a second attempt.
You are also welcome to contact DHL directly to set a new delivery date or arrange pickup from a nearby access point.
If a delivery still cannot be completed, the parcel may be returned to us, and redelivery may come with an additional fee.
If your order arrives damaged, or there are any issues with your delivery, contact us right away at sales@onyxhealth.net.
For lost parcels or customs holds, we handle each situation individually.
Customers are responsible for confirming that the products they order are permitted for import into their country of residence.
Placing an order with Onyx Research means you accept the terms outlined above.
We reserve the right to revise this policy at any time without advance notice.
